ai_result.long_description:
Keep everyday essentials organized and close at hand with this handmade leather EDC belt pouch. Crafted from premium Italian vegetable-tanned leather, it offers a compact way to carry coins, multiple credit cards, folded cash, and small EDC items such as a pocket knife, multitool, keys, flash drive, or lighter.

The pouch slides onto standard belts up to 1.57 inches (up to 40 mm) wide, keeping your essentials accessible without adding unnecessary bulk. Measuring 2.75 inches (70 mm) high, 4.33 inches (110 mm) wide, and 0.98 inches (25 mm) deep, it is a practical choice for everyday carry, outdoor use, or as a thoughtful gift for a hunter or anyone who prefers a streamlined belt setup.
